# Scenario: host .env STOREFRONT_* overrides the same key from project sidecar .env.
# README: host value wins; prefix stripped before write to infra/apps/<project>/.env.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: storefront with sidecar MARKER'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='

docker-assert-running apinfra_storefront-web
exists $HOME/infra/apps/storefront/.env
grep '^MARKER=from-host$' $HOME/infra/apps/storefront/.env
! grep 'from-sidecar' $HOME/infra/apps/storefront/.env

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: storefront
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/storefront/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- git-repo/dev/storefront/.env --
MARKER=from-sidecar

-- .env --
STOREFRONT_MARKER=from-host
